assets.name: workspace-wide
assets.kind: AI-generated concept — not an actual studio project
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: premium editorial architectural website hero concept, single wide landscape image, 16:9 composition, requested 1920 x 1080 pixels.
Primary request: Create one original photorealistic interior architecture photograph of a fictional high-end contemporary Indian workspace. This is a speculative concept, NOT a depiction of any real project or the actual Nerul project.
Scene and architecture: A generous, believable boutique workspace with warm limestone floors, lime-plaster walls and ceiling, dark teak and oak, a little restrained aged brass, and an elegant, plausible construction vocabulary. Deep dark timber joinery along the left side. Large floor-to-ceiling glazing across the back and right, with a refined dark metal window grid and an abstract hazy Indian city skyline outside. The skyline has no recognizable buildings, landmarks or stadium. A long generous oak communal working table and beautifully refined woven desk chairs occupy the right half. The interior feels calm, expensive, humane and quietly Indian contemporary, not a showroom.
Composition: Camera at human eye level, architectural magazine photography, 24–28mm tilt-shift lens, precise upright verticals, deep natural room perspective. Keep the left approximately 40 percent darker and relatively uncluttered so white website hero text can be overlaid there later. The warm workspace and furniture on the right are the main visual subject. Show enough floor, wall and window grid to enable a geometrically registered matching empty before view in a subsequent edit.
Lighting and material: Warm lateral natural daylight through the glazing, physically plausible soft shadows. Highly tactile imperfect limestone, lime plaster, subtle grain and joinery joints, real woven texture, restrained patina. An authentic photograph with subtle sensor grain and natural tonal range. Warm paper, charcoal and brass palette.
Constraints: This single image is the furnished AFTER image of a fictional concept. No text is rendered in the image. No people, text, captions, logos, watermarks, recognizable skyline landmarks, stadiums, excessive decoration, impossible structure, warped furniture, glossy CGI, plastic materials or oversaturated styling. Exactly one final image, no comparison panel, no contact sheet, no border.
qa: Inspected generated output and the saved local image.
Warm limestone, lime plaster, dark timber joinery, woven chairs and aged brass match the requested palette.
Table and chairs sit principally on the right; darker left cabinetry offers room for light hero copy.
No people, readable text, logos, watermarks, recognizable skyline landmarks or stadium observed.
Convincing editorial architectural concept with straight verticals and natural daylight.
